newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline heads up $4/$5.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline heads up $4/$5.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to firm on Wednesday, gasoline again dominant with barge gains of $4/$5 a tonne, dealers said.
Eurograde gasoline barges traded at $240.25 fob AR for prompt and $239 fob Rotterdam from August 11. Prompt material was offered in the range $240-$242 fob according to the grade.
Swaps were up a more modest $1/$2 a tonne with August swaps quoted at around $223/$225.
Heating oil barges were little changed as August IPE gas oil futures shuffled about Tuesday's closing range. Prompt and second half offers were at around IPE August +$1 fob Rotterdam.
Buyers, already scarce on Tuesday, were almost non-existent on Wednesday as the dollar again firmed against the mark, passing DM1.88.
High sulphur fuel oil barges gained about $1 a tonne fromm Tuesday's close with barge trades at $96.50 and $96.75 fob Rotterdam.
Later offers, from trading companies, were at around $97 fob Rotterdam. Refiners were still not offering product, traders said.
Bunker market demand was again low.
-- Philip Blenkinsop, Amsterdam Newsroom, +31 20 504 5000 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
